basic_details.job_title: IIEST Shibpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in
basic_details.application_mode: Soft copies via Email & Google Form, followed by Walk-in Interview

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Maximum 28 years. Upper age limit is exceeded by up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Woman/PWD/EWS as per Govt. of India and ANRF rules.

qualification.details: Desirable Qualification: GATE/NET qualification, experience of working in the related field, having experience in handling FTIR, Raman, DLS and other spectroscopic data, and having exposure to various Molecular Biology techniques.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 37,000/- to Rs. 48,100/- per month + HRA
salary_details.details: Initially for 06 months. It may be extended after evaluation on annual basis up to 36 months OR till the completion of the project, whichever happens earlier.

how_to_apply: Prepare your application letter on plain paper, recent CV (complete biodata), marksheets, and certificates (from 10th onwards), and Work Experience certificates (if any).
Combine all documents into a single PDF file.
Send the soft copies of the combined PDF file via email to [email protected].
Complete the Google Form provided at the official link.

Attend the walk-in interview on 27 October 2026 at Dr. Bolanath Chakraborty Memorial Fundamental Research Laboratory of Homoeopathy (Dr BCMFRLH) in Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology (IIEST), Shibpur, which is on the 1st Floor of the Science and Technology Building.
Bring physical copies of all documents at the time of the interview.
important_instructions: All documents should be in self-attested. Physical documents will be verified at the time of interview and joining. Selection will be canceled if any discrepancies are found in the documents at the time of physical verification. All applications must mention a valid e-mail address and phone number for further communication. Candidates must bring the physical copies to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment about?
faq.answer: It is for the recruitment of 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post on a contract basis at IIEST Shibpur under Project ID: CCRH-2/037/2025-26.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's degree in Pharmacy / Pharmaceutical Sciences / Medicine / Chemistry / Biochemistry / Physics / Biotechnology / Biomedical engineering / Natural sciences / Physiology / Food Technology OR any allied fields in Life Sciences from a recognized University OR Equivalent with first class or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years, with age relaxation up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Woman/PWD/EWS as per Govt. of India and ANRF rules.
